content.introduction: The next release of Real Earnings is scheduled for November 10, 2026, at 08:30 AM. This follows the pattern of previous releases, which have been published monthly at the same time. The schedule continues with December 2026's release on December 10, 2026, and January 2027's release on January 13, 2027. The most recent release, for October 2026, was published on November 10, 2026.
